description: Several large plastic building blocks in white, yellow, red, blue, and green are spread out on the bed in front of the hands. The left hand steadies a white base block near the center while the right hand brings pieces in from the right, pressing a yellow block onto the white, then snapping a red block and a blue block alongside it; the right hand then places a green block on top and finally adds another red block, releasing after each connection while the left hand continues to hold the growing stack in place.
